Application Data.NAME: Assembly Solutions, Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Assembly Solutions, Inc. provides assembly and packaging services for a variety of consumer products, focusing on efficient workflows, quality control, and adherence to safety standards. Our operations include manual and semi-automated assembly processes, ensuring that products are packaged securely for distribution. We prioritize employee safety through comprehensive training programs and maintain a robust risk management strategy. Our facility is equipped with advanced security measures, including video surveillance and secured storage areas, to protect our inventory and equipment. We do not handle hazardous materials, further minimizing risk exposure. Additionally, we perform regular maintenance on our machinery and conduct thorough inventory assessments to mitigate potential losses.
